Let $X$ be yearly health-care expense. The cutoff $c$ satisfies

$$P(X\le c)=0.33.$$

The 33rd standard-normal percentile is $z_{0.33}\approx-0.4399$. Therefore

$$c=\mu+z_{0.33}\sigma=3000+(-0.4399)(500)\approx2780.05.$$

A practical cutoff is approximately **2,780 dollars**.
